verses.en: The word of the Lord that came to Joel the son of Pethuel.
verses.fr: La parole de l''Eternel qui fut adressée à Joël, fils de Pethuel.
verses.am: ወደ ባቱኤል ልጅ ወደ ኢዩኤል የመጣው የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Hear this, ye old men, and give ear, all ye inhabitants of the land. Hath this been in your days, or even in the days of your fathers?
verses.fr: Ecoutez ceci, vieillards! Prêtez l''oreille, vous tous, habitants du pays! Rien de pareil est-il arrivé de votre temps, Ou du temps de vos pères?
verses.am: እናንተ ሽማግሌዎች፥ ይህን ስሙ፤ በምድርም የምትኖሩ ሁሉ፥ አድምጡ። ይህ በዘመናችሁ ወይስ በአባቶቻችሁ ዘመን ሆኖ ነበርን?

verses.en: Tell ye your children of it, and let your children tell their children, and their children another generation.
verses.fr: Racontez-le à vos enfants, Et que vos enfants le racontent à leurs enfants, Et leurs enfants à la génération qui suivra!
verses.am: ይህን ለልጆቻችሁ ንገሩ፤ ልጆቻችሁም ለልጆቻቸው፥ ልጆቻቸውም ለኋለኛው ትውልድ ይንገሩ።

verses.en: That which the palmerworm hath left hath the locust eaten; and that which the locust hath left hath the cankerworm eaten; and that which the cankerworm hath left hath the caterpiller eaten.
verses.fr: Ce qu''a laissé le gazam, la sauterelle l''a dévoré; Ce qu''a laissé la sauterelle, le jélek l''a dévoré; Ce qu''a laissé le jélek, le hasil l''a dévoré.
verses.am: ከተሞች የቀረውን አንበጣ በላው፤ ከአንበጣም የቀረውን ደጎብያ በላው፤ ከደጎብያም የቀረውን ኩብኩባ በላው።

verses.en: Awake, ye drunkards, and weep; and howl, all ye drinkers of wine, because of the new wine; for it is cut off from your mouth.
verses.fr: Réveillez-vous, ivrognes, et pleurez! Vous tous, buveurs de vin, gémissez, Parce que le moût vous est enlevé de la bouche!
verses.am: በተሃ ወይን ጠጃችሁ ከአፋችሁ ተወግዶአልና እናንተ ሰካራሞች፥ ነቅታችሁ አልቅሱ፤ እናንተም የወይን ጠጅ የምትጠጡ ሁሉ፥ ዋይ በሉ።

verses.en: For a nation is come up upon my land, strong, and without number, whose teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he hath the cheek teeth of a great lion.
verses.fr: Car un peuple est venu fondre sur mon pays, Puissant et innombrable. Il a les dents d''un lion, Les mâchoires d''une lionne.
verses.am: ቍጥርም የሌለው ብርቱ ሕዝብ በምድሬ ላይ ወጥቶአልና፤ ጥርሳቸው እንደ አንበሳ ጥርስ፥ መንጋጋቸውም እንደ እንስቲቱ አንበሳ መንጋጋ ነው።

verses.en: He hath laid my vine waste, and barked my fig tree: he hath made it clean bare, and cast it away; the branches thereof are made white.
verses.fr: Il a dévasté ma vigne; Il a mis en morceaux mon figuier, Il l''a dépouillé, abattu; Les rameaux de la vigne ont blanchi.
verses.am: ወይኔን ባዶ ምድር አደረገው፥ በለሴንም ሰበረው፤ ባዶም አደረገው፥ ጣለውም፤ ቅርንጫፎቹም ነጡ።

verses.en: Lament like a virgin girded with sackcloth for the husband of her youth.
verses.fr: Lamente-toi, comme la vierge qui se revêt d''un sac Pour pleurer l''ami de sa jeunesse!
verses.am: ለቍንጅናዋ ባል ማቅ ለብሳ እንደምታለቅስ ድንግል አልቅሺ።

verses.en: The meat offering and the drink offering is cut off from the house of the Lord; the priests, the Lord's ministers, mourn.
verses.fr: Offrandes et libations disparaissent de la maison de l''Eternel; Les sacrificateurs, serviteurs de l''Eternel, sont dans le deuil.
verses.am: የእህሉ ቍርባንና የመጠጡ ቍርባን ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ተወግዶአል፤ የእግዚአብሔርም አገልጋዮች ካህናቱ አለቀሱ።

verses.en: The field is wasted, the land mourneth; for the corn is wasted: the new wine is dried up, the oil languisheth.
verses.fr: Les champs sont ravagés, La terre est attristée; Car les blés sont détruits, Le moût est tari, l''huile est desséchée.
verses.am: እህሉ ጠፍቶአልና፥ ወይኑም ደርቆአልና፥ ዘይቱም ጐድሎአልና እርሻው ምድረ በዳ ሆኖአል፥ ምድሪቱም አልቅሳለች።

verses.en: Be ye ashamed, O ye husbandmen; howl, O ye vinedressers, for the wheat and for the barley; because the harvest of the field is perished.
verses.fr: Les laboureurs sont consternés, les vignerons gémissent, A cause du froment et de l''orge, Parce que la moisson des champs est perdue.
verses.am: መከሩ ከእርሻቸው ጠፍቶአልና ገበሬዎች ስለ ስንዴውና ስለ ገብሱ አፈሩ፤ የወይን አትክልተኞችም አለቀሱ።

verses.en: The vine is dried up, and the fig tree languisheth; the pomegranate tree, the palm tree also, and the apple tree, even all the trees of the field, are withered: because joy is withered away from the sons of men.
verses.fr: La vigne est confuse, Le figuier languissant; Le grenadier, le palmier, le pommier, Tous les arbres des champs sont flétris... La joie a cessé parmi les fils de l''homme!
verses.am: ወይኑ ደርቆአል፥ በለሱም ጠውልጎአል፤ ሮማኑና ተምሩ እንኰዩም የምድርም ዛፎች ሁሉ ደርቀዋል፤ ደስታም ከሰው ልጆች ዘንድ ርቆአል።

verses.en: Gird yourselves, and lament, ye priests: howl, ye ministers of the altar: come, lie all night in sackcloth, ye ministers of my God: for the meat offering and the drink offering is withholden from the house of your God.
verses.fr: Sacrificateurs, ceignez-vous et pleurez! Lamentez-vous, serviteurs de l''autel! Venez, passez la nuit revêtus de sacs, Serviteurs de mon Dieu! Car offrandes et libations ont disparu de la maison de votre Dieu.
verses.am: የእህሉ ቍርባንና የመጠጡ ቍርባን ከአምላካችሁ ቤት ቀርቶአልና እናንተ ካህናት፥ ማቅ ታጥቃችሁ አልቅሱ፤ እናንተም የመሠዊያ አገልጋዮች፥ ዋይ በሉ፤ እናንተ የአምላኬ አገልጋዮች፥ ኑ፥ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ በማቅ ላይ ተኙ።

verses.en: Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of the Lord your God, and cry unto the Lord,
verses.fr: Publiez un jeûne, une convocation solennelle! Assemblez les vieillards, tous les habitants du pays, Dans la maison de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, Et criez à l''Eternel!
verses.am: ጾምን ቀድሱ፥ ጉባኤውንም አውጁ፤ ሽምግሌዎችንና በምድር የሚኖሩትን ሁሉ ወደ አምላካችሁ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ሰብስቡ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጩኹ።

verses.en: Alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is at hand, and as a destruction from the Almighty shall it come.
verses.fr: Ah! quel jour! Car le jour de l''Eternel est proche: Il vient comme un ravage du Tout-Puissant.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ቀርቦአልና ለቀኑ ወዮ! እርሱም ሁሉን ከሚችል ከአምላክ ዘንድ እንደ ጥፋት ይመጣል።

verses.en: Is not the meat cut off before our eyes, yea, joy and gladness from the house of our God?
verses.fr: La nourriture n''est-elle pas enlevée sous nos yeux? La joie et l''allégresse n''ont-elles pas disparu de la maison de notre Dieu?
verses.am: ከዓይናችን ፊት ምግብ፥ ከአምላካችንም ቤት ደስታና እልልታ የጠፋ አይደለምን?

verses.en: The seed is rotten under their clods, the garners are laid desolate, the barns are broken down; for the corn is withered.
verses.fr: Les semences ont séché sous les mottes; Les greniers sont vides, Les magasins sont en ruines, Car il n''y a point de blé.
verses.am: ዘሩ በምድር ውስጥ በሰበሰ፤ እህሉ ደርቆአልና ጎተራዎቹ ባዶ ናቸው፥ ጎታዎቹም ፈርሰዋል።

verses.en: How do the beasts groan! the herds of cattle are perplexed, because they have no pasture; yea, the flocks of sheep are made desolate.
verses.fr: Comme les bêtes gémissent! Les troupeaux de boeufs sont consternés, Parce qu''ils sont sans pâturage; Et même les troupeaux de brebis sont en souffrance.
verses.am: እንስሶች እጅግ ጮኹ፤ የላምም መንጎች ማሰማርያ የላቸውምና ተጠራጠሩ፤ የበግም መንጎች ጠፍተዋል።

verses.en: O Lord, to thee will I cry: for the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness, and the flame hath burned all the trees of the field.
verses.fr: C''est vers toi que je crie, ô Eternel! Car le feu a dévoré les plaines du désert, Et la flamme a brûlé tous les arbres des champs.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ እሳት የምድረ በዳውን ማሰማርያ በልቶአልና፥ ነበልባሉም የዱሩን ዛፍ ሁሉ አቃጥሎአልና ወደ አንተ እጮኻለሁ።

verses.en: The beasts of the field cry also unto thee: for the rivers of waters are dried up, and the fire hath devoured the pastures of the wilderness.
verses.fr: Les bêtes des champs crient aussi vers toi; Car les torrents sont à sec, Et le feu a dévoré les plaines du désert.
verses.am: ፈሳሹ ውኃ ደርቆአልና፥ እሳቱም የምድረ በዳውን ማሰማርያ በልቶአልና የምድር አራዊት ወደ አንተ አለኸለኩ።

verses.en: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the Lord cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
verses.fr: Sonnez de la trompette en Sion! Faites-la retentir sur ma montagne sainte! Que tous les habitants du pays tremblent! Car le jour de l''Eternel vient, car il est proche,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን መጥቶአልና፥ እርሱም ቀርቦአልና በጽዮን መለከትን ንፉ፥ በቅዱሱም ተራራዬ ላይ እሪ በሉ፤ በምድርም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ ይንቀጥቀጡ፤ የእግዚአብሔር ቀን መጥቶአልና፤

verses.en: A day of darkness and of gloominess, a day of clouds and of thick darkness, as the morning spread upon the mountains: a great people and a strong; there hath not been ever the like, neither shall be any more after it, even to the years of many generations.
verses.fr: Jour de ténèbres et d''obscurité, Jour de nuées et de brouillards, Il vient comme l''aurore se répand sur les montagnes. Voici un peuple nombreux et puissant, Tel qu''il n''y en a jamais eu, Et qu''il n''y en aura jamais dans la suite des âges.
verses.am: የጨለማና የጭጋግ ቀን፥ የደመናና የድቅድቅ ጨለማ ቀን ነው፤ ታላቅና ብርቱ ሕዝብ በተራሮች ላይ እንደ ወገግታ ተዘርግቶአል፤ ከዘላለምም ጀምሮ እንደ እነርሱ ያለ አልነበረም፥ ከእነርሱም በኋላ እስከ ብዙ ትውልድ ድረስ እንደ እነርሱ ያለ ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይሆንም።

verses.en: A fire devoureth before them; and behind them a flame burneth: the land is as the garden of Eden before them, and behind them a desolate wilderness; yea, and nothing shall escape them.
verses.fr: Devant lui est un feu dévorant, Et derrière lui une flamme brûlante; Le pays était auparavant comme un jardin d''Eden, Et depuis, c''est un désert affreux: Rien ne lui échappe.
verses.am: እሳት በፊታቸው ትባላለች፥ በኋላቸውም ነበልባል ታቃጥላለች፤ ምድሪቱ በፊታቸው እንደ ዔድን ገነት፥ በኋላቸውም የምድረ በዳ በረሃ ናት፤ ከእነርሱም የሚያመልጥ የለም።

verses.en: The appearance of them is as the appearance of horses; and as horsemen, so shall they run.
verses.fr: A les voir, on dirait des chevaux, Et ils courent comme des cavaliers.
verses.am: መልካቸው እንደ ፈረስ መልክ ነው፥ እንደ ፈረሶችም ይሮጣሉ።

verses.en: Like the noise of chariots on the tops of mountains shall they leap, like the noise of a flame of fire that devoureth the stubble, as a strong people set in battle array.
verses.fr: A les entendre, on dirait un bruit de chars Sur le sommet des montagnes où ils bondissent, On dirait un pétillement de la flamme du feu, Quand elle consume le chaume. C''est comme une armée puissante Qui se prépare au combat.
verses.am: በተራራ ላይ እንዳሉ ሰረገሎች ድምፅ፥ ገለባውንም እንደሚበላ እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ድምፅ፥ ለሰልፍም እንደ ተዘጋጀ እንደ ብርቱ ሕዝብ ያኰበኵባሉ።

verses.en: Before their face the people shall be much pained: all faces shall gather blackness.
verses.fr: Devant eux les peuples tremblent, Tous les visages pâlissent.
verses.am: ከፊታቸው አሕዛብ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ የሰውም ፊት ሁሉ ይጠቍራል።

verses.en: They shall run like mighty men; they shall climb the wall like men of war; and they shall march every one on his ways, and they shall not break their ranks:
verses.fr: Ils s''élancent comme des guerriers, Ils escaladent les murs comme des gens de guerre; Chacun va son chemin, Sans s''écarter de sa route.
verses.am: እንደ ኃያላን ይሮጣሉ፥ እንደ ሰልፈኞችም በቅጥሩ ላይ ይወጣሉ፤ እያንዳንዱም በመንገዱ ላይ ይራመዳል፥ ከእርምጃቸውም አያፈገፍጉም።

verses.en: Neither shall one thrust another; they shall walk every one in his path: and when they fall upon the sword, they shall not be wounded.
verses.fr: Ils ne se pressent point les uns les autres, Chacun garde son rang; Ils se précipitent au travers des traits Sans arrêter leur marche.
verses.am: አንዱ ካንዱ ጋር አይጋፉም፥ እያንዳንዱም መንገዱን ይጠበጥባል፤ በሰልፍ መካከል ያልፋሉ፥ እነርሱም አይቈስሉም።

verses.en: They shall run to and fro in the city; they shall run upon the wall, they shall climb up upon the houses; they shall enter in at the windows like a thief.
verses.fr: Ils se répandent dans la ville, Courent sur les murailles, Montent sur les maisons, Entrent par les fenêtres comme un voleur.
verses.am: በከተማም ያኰበkWbaሉ፥ በቅጥሩም ላይ ይሮጣሉ፤ ወደ ቤቶችም ይወጣሉ፥ እንደ ሌባም በመስኮቶች ይገባሉ።

verses.en: The earth shall quake before them; the heavens shall tremble: the sun and the moon shall be dark, and the stars shall withdraw their shining:
verses.fr: Devant eux la terre tremble, Les cieux sont ébranlés, Le soleil et la lune s''obscurcissent, Et les étoiles retirent leur éclat.
verses.am: ምድሪቱም ከፊታቸው ትናወጣለች፥ ሰማያትም ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ ፀሐይና ጨረቃም ይጨልማሉ፥ ከዋክብትም ብርሃናቸውን ይሰውራሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord shall utter his voice before his army: for his camp is very great: for he is strong that executeth his word: for the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; and who can abide it?
verses.fr: L''Eternel fait entendre sa voix devant son armée; Car son camp est immense, Et l''exécuteur de sa parole est puissant; Car le jour de l''Eternel est grand, il est terrible: Qui pourra le soutenir?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሠራዊቱ ፊት ድምፁን ይሰጣል፤ ሰፈሩ እጅግ ብዙ ነውና፥ ቃሉንም የሚያደርግ እርሱ ኃያል ነውና፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቀን ታላቅና እጅግ የሚያስፈራ ነውና ማንስ ይችለዋል?

verses.en: Therefore also now, saith the Lord, turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:
verses.fr: Maintenant encore, dit l''Eternel, Revenez à moi de tout votre coeur, Avec des jeûnes, avec des pleurs et des lamentations!
verses.am: አሁንስ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፥ በፍጹም ልባችሁ፥ በጾምም፥ በልቅሶና በዋይታ ወደ እኔ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto the Lord your God: for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.
verses.fr: Déchirez vos coeurs et non vos vêtements, Et revenez à l''Eternel, votre Dieu; Car il est compatissant et miséricordieux, Lent à la colère et riche en bonté, Et il se repent des maux qu''il envoie.
verses.am: ልባችሁን እንጂ ልብሳችሁን አትቅደዱ፤ አምላካችሁም እግዚአብሔር ቸርና መሐሪ፥ KWTaው የዘገየ፥ ምሕረቱም የበዛ፥ ለክፋትም የተጸጸተ ነውና ወደ እርሱ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: Who knoweth if he will return and repent, and leave a blessing behind him; even a meat offering and a drink offering unto the Lord your God?
verses.fr: Qui sait s''il ne reviendra pas et ne se repentira pas, Et s''il ne laissera pas après lui la bénédiction, Des offrandes et des libations pour l''Eternel, votre Dieu?
verses.am: የሚመለስና የሚጸጸት እንደ ሆነ፥ ለአምላካችሁም ለእግዚአብሔር የእህልና የመጠጥ KWrባን የሚሆነውን በረከት የሚያተርፍ እንደ ሆነ ማን ያውቃል?

verses.en: Blow the trumpet in Zion, sanctify a fast, call a solemn assembly:
verses.fr: Sonnez de la trompette en Sion! Publiez un jeûne, une convocation solennelle!
verses.am: በጽዮን መለከትን ንፉ፥ ጾምንም ቀድሱ፥ ጉባኤውንም አውጁ፥

verses.en: Gather the people, sanctify the congregation, assemble the elders, gather the children, and those that suck the breasts: let the bridegroom go forth of his chamber, and the bride out of her closet.
verses.fr: Assemblez le peuple, formez une sainte réunion! Assemblez les vieillards, Assemblez les enfants, Même les nourrissons à la mamelle! Que l''époux sorte de sa demeure, Et l''épouse de sa chambre!
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም አከማቹ፥ ማኅበሩንም ቀድሱ፥ ሽማግሌዎቹንም ሰብስቡ፥ ሕፃናቱንና ጡት የሚጠቡትን አከማቹ፤ ሙሽራው ከእልፍኙ፥ ሙሽራይቱም ከጫጉላዋ ይውጡ።

verses.en: Let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep between the porch and the altar, and let them say, Spare thy people, O Lord, and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them: wherefore should they say among the people, Where is their God?
verses.fr: Qu''entre le portique et l''autel Pleurent les sacrificateurs, Serviteurs de l''Eternel, Et qu''ils disent: Eternel, épargne ton peuple! Ne livre pas ton héritage à l''opprobre, Aux railleries des nations! Pourquoi dirait-on parmi les peuples: Où est leur Dieu?
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም አገልጋዬች ካህናት ከወለሉና ከመሠዊያው መካከል እያለቀሱ። አቤቱ፥ ለሕዝብህ ራራ፥ አሕዛብም እንዳይነቅፉአቸው ርስትህን ለማላገጫ አሳልፈህ አትስጥ፤ ከአሕዛብ መካከል። አምላካቸው ወዴት ነው? ስለ ምን ይላሉ? ይበሉ።

verses.en: Then will the Lord be jealous for his land, and pity his people.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est ému de jalousie pour son pays, Et il épargne son peuple.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ስለ ምድሩ ቀና፥ ለሕዝቡም ራራለት።

verses.en: Yea, the Lord will answer and say unto his people, Behold, I will send you corn, and wine, and oil, and ye shall be satisfied therewith: and I will no more make you a reproach among the heathen:
verses.fr: L''Eternel répond, il dit à son peuple: Voici, je vous enverrai du blé, Du moût et de l''huile, Et vous en serez rassasiés; Et je ne vous livrerai plus à l''opprobre parmi les nations.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም መልሶ ሕዝቡን። እነሆ፥ እህልንና ወይንን ዘይትንም እሰድድላችኋለሁ፥ እናንተም በእርሱ ትጠግባላችሁ፤ ከእንግዲህም ወዲያ በአሕዛብ መካከል መሰደቢያ አላደርጋችሁም።

verses.en: But I will remove far off from you the northern army, and will drive him into a land barren and desolate, with his face toward the east sea, and his hinder part toward the utmost sea, and his stink shall come up, and his ill savour shall come up, because he hath done great things.
verses.fr: J''éloignerai de vous l''ennemi du nord, Je le chasserai vers une terre aride et déserte, Son avant-garde dans la mer orientale, Son arrière-garde dans la mer occidentale; Et son infection se répandra, Sa puanteur s''élèvera dans les airs, Parce qu''il a fait de grandes choses.
verses.am: የሰሜንንም ሠራዊት ከእናንተ ዘንድ አርቃለሁ፥ ወደ በረሃና ወደ ምድረበዳ፥ ፊቱን ወደ ምሥራቁ ባሕር ጀርባውንም ወደ ምዕራቡ ባሕር አድርጌ አሳድደዋለሁ፤ እርሱም ትዕቢትን አድርጎአልና ግማቱ ይወጣል፥ ክርፋቱም ይነሣል አለ።

verses.en: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice: for the Lord will do great things.
verses.fr: Terre, ne crains pas, Sois dans l''allégresse et réjouis-toi, Car l''Eternel fait de grandes choses!
verses.am: ምድር ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ታላቅ ነገር አድርጎአልና አትፍሪ፥ ደስም ይበልሽ፥ እልልም በዪ።

verses.en: Be not afraid, ye beasts of the field: for the pastures of the wilderness do spring, for the tree beareth her fruit, the fig tree and the vine do yield their strength.
verses.fr: Bêtes des champs, ne craignez pas, Car les plaines du désert reverdiront, Car les arbres porteront leurs fruits, Le figuier et la vigne donneront leurs richesses.
verses.am: እናንተ የምድር እንስሶች ሆይ፥ የምድር በዳው ማሰማርያ ለምልሞአልና፥ ዛፉም ፍሬውን አፍርቶአልና፥ በለሱና ወይኑም ኃይላቸውን ሰጥተዋልና አትፍሩ።

verses.en: Be glad then, ye children of Zion, and rejoice in the Lord your God: for he hath given you the former rain moderately, and he will cause to come down for you the rain, the former rain, and the latter rain in the first month.
verses.fr: Et vous, enfants de Sion, soyez dans l''allégresse et réjouissez-vous En l''Eternel, votre Dieu, Car il vous donnera la pluie en son temps, Il vous enverra la pluie de la première et de l''arrière-saison, Comme autrefois.
verses.am: እናንተ የጽዮን ልጆች፥ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር የፊተኛውን ዝናብ በጽድቅ ሰጥቶአችኋልና፥ እንደ ቀድሞውም የፊተኛውንና የኋለኛውን ዝናብ አዝንቦላችኋልና በእርሱ ደስ ይበላችሁ፥ ለእርሱም እልል በሉ።

verses.en: And the floors shall be full of wheat, and the vats shall overflow with wine and oil.
verses.fr: Les aires se rempliront de blé, Et les cuves regorgeront de moût et d''huile.
verses.am: አውድማዎችም እህልን ይሞላሉ፥ መጥመቂያዎችም የወይን ጠጅንና ዘይትን አትረፍርፈው ያፈስሳሉ።

verses.en: And I will restore to you the years that the locust hath eaten, the cankerworm, and the caterpiller, and the palmerworm, my great army which I sent among you.
verses.fr: Je vous remplacerai les années Qu''ont dévorées la sauterelle, Le jélek, le hasil et le gazam, Ma grande armée que j''avais envoyée contre vous.
verses.am: የሰደድሁባችሁ ታላቁ ሠራዊቴ አንበጣና ደጎብያ ኩብኩባና ተምች የበላቸውን ዓመታት እመልስላችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall eat in plenty, and be satisfied, and praise the name of the Lord your God, that hath dealt wondrously with you: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.fr: Vous mangerez et vous vous rassasierez, Et vous célébrerez le nom de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, Qui aura fait pour vous des prodiges; Et mon peuple ne sera plus jamais dans la confusion.
verses.am: ብዙ መብል ትበላላችሁ፥ ትጠግቡማላችሁ፤ ከእናንተም ጋር ተአምራትን የሠራውን የአምላካችሁን የእግዚአብሔርን ስም ታመሰግናላችሁ፤ ሕዝቤም ለዘላለም አያፍርም።

verses.en: And ye shall know that I am in the midst of Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and none else: and my people shall never be ashamed.
verses.fr: Et vous saurez que je suis au milieu d''Israël, Que je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et qu''il n''y en a point d''autre, Et mon peuple ne sera plus jamais dans la confusion.
verses.am: እኔም በእስራኤል መካከል እንዳለሁ፥ እኔም አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ፥ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ አምላክ እንደሌለ ታውቃላችሁ፤ ሕዝቤም ለዘላለም አያፍርም።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:
verses.fr: Après cela, je répandrai mon esprit sur toute chair; Vos fils et vos filles prophétiseront, Vos vieillards auront des songes, Et vos jeunes gens des visions.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ መንፈሴን በሥጋ ለባሽ ሁሉ ላይ አፈስሳለሁ፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁም ትንቢት ይናገራሉ፥ ሽማግሌዎቻችሁም ሕልምን ያልማሉ፥ ጐበዞቻችሁም ራእይ ያያሉ፤

verses.en: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit.
verses.fr: Même sur les serviteurs et sur les servantes, Dans ces jours-là, je répandrai mon esprit.
verses.am: ደግሞም በዚያ ወራት በወንዶችና በሴቶች ባሪያዎች ላይ መንፈሴን አፈስሳለሁ፤

verses.en: And I will shew wonders in the heavens and in the earth, blood, and fire, and pillars of smoke.
verses.fr: Je ferai paraître des prodiges dans les cieux et sur la terre, Du sang, du feu, et des colonnes de fumée;
verses.am: በላይ በሰማይ ድንቆችን አሳያለሁ፥ በታች በምድርም ደምና እሳት የጢስም ጭጋግ።

verses.en: The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of the Lord come.
verses.fr: Le soleil se changera en ténèbres, Et la lune en sang, Avant l''arrivée du jour de l''Eternel, De ce jour grand et terrible.
verses.am: ታላቁና የሚያስፈራው የእግዚአብሔር ቀን ሳይመጣ ፀሐይ ወደ ጨለማ፥ ጨረቃም ወደ ደም ይለወጣል።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be delivered: for in mount Zion and in Jerusalem shall be deliverance, as the Lord hath said, and in the remnant whom the Lord shall call.
verses.fr: Alors quiconque invoquera le nom de l''Eternel sera sauvé; Le salut sera sur la montagne de Sion et à Jérusalem, Comme a dit l''Eternel, Et parmi les réchappés que l''Eternel appellera.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የእግዚአብሔር ስም የሚጠራ ሁሉ ይድናል፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተናገረ፥ በጽዮን ተራራና በኢየሩሳሌም መድኃኒት ይገኛል። ደግሞም እግዚአብሔር የጠራቸው፥ የምስራች የሚሰበከላቸው ይገኛሉ።

verses.en: For, behold, in those days, and in that time, when I shall bring again the captivity of Judah and Jerusalem,
verses.fr: Car voici, en ces jours, en ce temps-là, Quand je ramènerai les captifs de Juda et de Jérusalem,
verses.am: እነሆም፥ በዚህ ወራትና በዚህ ዘመን፥ የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን ምርኮ በምመልስበት ጊዜ፥

verses.en: I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.
verses.fr: Je rassemblerai toutes les nations, Et je les ferai descendre dans la vallée de Josaphat; Là, j''entrerai en jugement avec elles, Au sujet de mon peuple, d''Israël, mon héritage, Qu''elles ont dispersé parmi les nations, Et au sujet de mon pays qu''elles se sont partagé.
verses.am: አሕዛብን ሁሉ ሰብስቤ ወደ ኢዮሣፍጥ ሸለቆ አወርዳቸዋለሁ፤ በዚያም ስለ ሕዝቤና ስለ ርስቴ ስለ እስራኤል በአሕዛብ መካከል የበተኑአቸውን ምድሬንም የተካፈሉአትን እፋረድባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And they have cast lots for my people; and have given a boy for an harlot, and sold a girl for wine, that they might drink.
verses.fr: Ils ont tiré mon peuple au sort; Ils ont donné le jeune garçon pour une prostituée, Ils ont vendu la jeune fille pour du vin, et ils ont bu.
verses.am: በሕዝቤም ላይ ዕጣ ተጣጣሉ፤ ወንድ ልጅን ለጋለሞታ ዋጋ ሰጡ፥ ሴት ልጅን ለወይን ጠጅ ሸጡ፥ ጠጡም።

verses.en: Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
verses.fr: Que me voulez-vous, Tyr et Sidon, Et vous tous, districts des Philistins? Voulez-vous tirer vengeance de moi? Si vous voulez vous venger, Je ferai bien vite retomber votre vengeance sur vos têtes.
verses.am: ጢሮስና ሲዶና የፍልስጥኤምም ግዛት ሁሉ ሆይ፥ ከእናንተ ጋር ለእኔ ምን አለኝ? በውኑ ብድራትን ትመልሱልኛላችሁን? ብድራትን ብትመልሱልኝ ፈጥኜ በችኰላ ብድራታችሁን በራሳችሁ ላይ እመልሳለሁ።

verses.en: Because ye have taken my silver and my gold, and have carried into your temples my goodly pleasant things:
verses.fr: Vous avez pris mon argent mon or; Et ce que j''avais de plus précieux et de plus beau, Vous l''avez emporté dans vos temples.
verses.am: ብሬንና ወርቄን ወስዳችኋልና፥ የተወደደውንም መልካሙን ዕቃዬን ወደ መቅደሳችሁ አግብታችኋልና፥

verses.en: The children also of Judah and the children of Jerusalem have ye sold unto the Grecians, that ye might remove them far from their border.
verses.fr: Vous avez vendu les enfants de Juda et de Jérusalem aux enfants de Javan, Afin de les éloigner de leur territoire.
verses.am: ከዳርቻቸውም ታርቁአቸው ዘንድ የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን ልጆች ለግሪክ ሰዎች ሸጣችኋልና፥

verses.en: Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
verses.fr: Voici, je les ferai revenir du lieu où vous les avez vendus, Et je ferai retomber votre vengeance sur vos têtes.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እነርሱን ከሸጣችሁበት ስፍራ አስነሣቸዋለሁ፥ ብድራታችሁንም በራሳችሁ ላይ እመልሳለሁ።

verses.en: And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hand of the children of Judah, and they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.fr: Je vendrai vos fils et vos filles aux enfants de Juda, Et ils les vendront aux Sabéens, nation lointaine; Car l''Eternel a parlé.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ተናግሮአልና ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁን በይሁዳ ልጆች እጅ እሸጣለሁ፥ እነርሱም ለሩቆቹ ሕዝብ ለሳባ ሰዎች ይሸጡአችኋል።

verses.en: Proclaim ye this among the Gentiles; Prepare war, wake up the mighty men, let all the men of war draw near; let them come up:
verses.fr: Publiez ces choses parmi les nations! Préparez la guerre! Réveillez les héros! Qu''ils s''approchent, qu''ils montent, Tous les hommes de guerre!
verses.am: ይህን በአሕዛብ መካከል አውጁ ለሰልፍ ተዘጋጁ ኃያላንን አስነሡ ሰልፈኞች ሁሉ ይቅረቡ ይውጡም።

verses.en: Beat your plowshares into swords and your pruninghooks into spears: let the weak say, I am strong.
verses.fr: De vos hoyaux forgez des épées, Et de vos serpes des lances! Que le faible dise: Je suis fort!
verses.am: ማረሻችሁን ሰይፍ፥ ማጭዳችሁንም ጦር ለማድረግ ቀጥቅጡ፤ ደካማውም። እኔ ብርቱ ነኛ ይበል።

verses.en: Assemble yourselves, and come, all ye heathen, and gather yourselves together round about: thither cause thy mighty ones to come down, O Lord.
verses.fr: Hâtez-vous et venez, vous toutes, nations d''alentour, Et rassemblez-vous! Là, ô Eternel, fais descendre tes héros!
verses.am: እናንተ በዙሪያ ያላችሁ አሕዛብ ሁሉ፥ ቸkWlaችሁ ኑ፥ ተሰብሰቡ፤ አቤቱ፥ ኃያላኖችህን ወደዚያ አውርድ።

verses.en: Let the heathen be wakened, and come up to the valley of Jehoshaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the heathen round about.
verses.fr: Que les nations se réveillent, et qu''elles montent Vers la vallée de Josaphat! Car là je siégerai pour juger toutes les nations d''alentour.
verses.am: አሕዛብ ይነሡ፥ ወደ ኢዮሣፍጥ ሸለቆም ይውጡ፤ በዙሪያ ባሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ እፈርድ ዘንድ በዚያ እቀመጣለሁና።

verses.en: Put ye in the sickle, for the harvest is ripe: come, get you down; for the press is full, the fats overflow; for their wickedness is great.
verses.fr: Saisissez la faucille, Car la moisson est mûre! Venez, foulez, Car le pressoir est plein, Les cuves regorgent! Car grande est leur méchanceté,
verses.am: መከሩ ደርሶአልና ማጭድ ስደዱ መጥመቂያውም ሞልቶአልና ኑ እርገጡ፤ ክፉታቸውም በዝቶአልና መጥመቂያ ሁሉ ፈርሶአል።

verses.en: Multitudes, multitudes in the valley of decision: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of decision.
verses.fr: C''est une multitude, une multitude, Dans la vallée du jugement; Car le jour de l''Eternel est proche, Dans la vallée du jugement.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር ቀን በፍርድ ሸለቆ ቀርቦአልና የብዙ ብዙ ሕዝብ ውካታ በፍርድ ሸለቆ አለ።

verses.en: The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their shining.
verses.fr: Le soleil et la lune s''obscurcissent, Et les étoiles retirent leur éclat.
verses.am: ፀሐይና ጨረቃ ጨልመዋል፥ ከዋክብትም ብርሃናቸውን ሰውረዋል።

verses.en: The Lord also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the Lord will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: De Sion l''Eternel rugit, De Jérusalem il fait entendre sa voix; Les cieux et la terre sont ébranlés. Mais l''Eternel est un refuge pour son peuple, Un abri pour les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በጽዮን ሆኖ ድምፁን ከፍ አድርጎ ይጮኻል፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሆኖ ቃሉን ይሰጣል፤ ሰማይና ምድርም ይናወጣሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን ለሕዝቡ መሸሸጊያ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች መጠጊያ ይሆናል።

verses.en: So shall ye know that I am the Lord your God dwelling in Zion, my holy mountain: then shall Jerusalem be holy, and there shall no strangers pass through her any more.
verses.fr: Et vous saurez que je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu, Résidant à Sion, ma sainte montagne. Jérusalem sera sainte, Et les étrangers n''y passeront plus.
verses.am: እኔም በተቀደሰው ተራራዬ በጽዮን የምቀመጥ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሆንሁ ታውቃላችሁ፤ የዚያን ጊዜም ኢየሩሳሌም የተቀደሰች ትሆናለች፥ እንግዶችም ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አያልፉባትም።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the mountains shall drop down new wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the rivers of Judah shall flow with waters, and a fountain shall come forth out of the house of the Lord, and shall water the valley of Shittim.
verses.fr: En ce temps-là, le moût ruissellera des montagnes, Le lait coulera des collines, Et il y aura de l''eau dans tous les torrents de Juda; Une source sortira aussi de la maison de l''Eternel, Et arrosera la vallée de Sittim.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ተራሮች በተሃ ጠጅ ያንጠባጥባሉ፥ ኮረብቶችም ወተትን ያፈስሳሉ፥ በይሁዳም ያሉት ፈፋዎች ሁሉ ውኃን ያጐርፋሉ ከእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ምንጭ ትፈልቃለች፥ የሰጢምንም ሸለቆ ታጠጣለች።

verses.en: Egypt shall be a desolation, and Edom shall be a desolate wilderness, for the violence against the children of Judah, because they have shed innocent blood in their land.
verses.fr: L''Egypte sera dévastée, Edom sera réduit en désert, A cause des violences contre les enfants de Juda, Dont ils ont répandu le sang innocent dans leur pays.
verses.am: በአገራቸው ንጹሑን ደም አፍስሰዋልና በይሁዳ ልጆች ላይ ስላደረጉት ግፍ ግብጽ ምድረ በዳ፥ ኤዶምያስም በረሃ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But Judah shall dwell for ever, and Jerusalem from generation to generation.
verses.fr: Mais Juda sera toujours habité, Et Jérusalem, de génération en génération.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይሁዳ ለዘላለም፥ ኢየሩሳሌምም ለልጅ ልጅ መኖሪያ ይሆናል።

verses.en: For I will cleanse their blood that I have not cleansed: for the Lord dwelleth in Zion.
verses.fr: Je vengerai leur sang que je n''ai point encore vengé, Et L''Eternel résidera dans Sion.
verses.am: እኔም ንጹሕ ያላደረግሁትን ደማቸውን ንጹሕ አደርገዋለሁ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በጽዮን ያድራል።
